fields.label: Devices
fields.description: One row per ZKTeco device. Device ID is any name you choose; it is stored on every Employee Checkin.

fields.label: Shift Type Device Mapping
fields.description:
Optional. Links Shift Types to the devices in the table above so HRMS auto attendance knows until when check-ins are complete. After every successful pull from a shift's devices, the Shift Type's "Last Sync of Checkin" is set to the pull time. Format: a JSON list, one entry per Shift Type, using the exact Shift Type names and the Device IDs from the table above. Example:
[{"shift_type_name": "Morning Shift", "related_device_id": ["main-entrance"]}, {"shift_type_name": "Evening Shift", "related_device_id": ["main-entrance", "back-gate"]}]
Leave it as [] if you do not use auto attendance.
